'''Crab rotoven''' was a variety of food that was favored by [[Veilred Jydor]], a financier who operated the [[High Card Casino]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Danteel]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
